_README: Which code version produced each seed recording.
eval-run pools seeds to compute per-expectation hit rates. Pooling samples
from DIFFERENT pipeline code silently mixes populations: the resulting
STABLE/FLAKY/ABSENT labels then describe no version in particular. That is
the same failure mode as the stale-precision bug — a number that looks
A filename suffix cannot enforce this, so the grouping lives here. Seeds
with no entry are reported as code 'unknown' and grouped separately rather
than being folded into a real group.
code        stable label for one pipeline version; seeds sharing it are
genuinely comparable and may be pooled
sha         commit the recording ran against
note        what changed, so the groups can be read as a sequence

golden-seed-08-mtplx27b.json.note: M-01 Step 0 baseline: provider MTPLX (local), model Youssofal--Qwen3.8-27B-MTPLX-Optimized-Speed, PARITY_THINKING=off, MTPLX supervisor with --paged-kv-quantization q8. All 12/12 components covered (166 threats); mitigations + LLM dedup passes failed under GPU memory pressure near the end of the run (HTTP 507) and are absent from this snapshot, so mitigationCount is 0 throughout — does not affect recall/precision, which key on name/category/componentId only.

golden-seed-09-mtplx27b.json.note: M-01 Step 0 baseline, second recording, same config as seed 08 (no server restart between seeds 1 and 2). All 12/12 components covered (163 threats) with zero 507s during category analysis — same pattern as seed 08: GPU memory pressure (164 x HTTP 507) hit only mitigations + LLM dedup, after all category analysis had completed cleanly. mitigationCount is 0 throughout.

golden-seed-10-mtplx27b.json.note: M-01 Step 0 baseline, third recording. MTPLX supervisor restarted (launchctl kickstart) and reconfirmed --paged-kv-quantization q8 before this seed, per the session bank's observed ~40-50min accumulation limit. All 12/12 components covered (169 threats) with zero 507s during category analysis; 180 x HTTP 507 again hit only mitigations + LLM dedup at the end. mitigationCount is 0 throughout.

golden-seed-11-mtplx27b-x06.json.note: Wave X token baseline (X-01 meter + X-06 in-flight limiter, no prompt change), same MTPLX config as seeds 08-10 (PARITY_THINKING=off, q8). MTPLX process started 2026-09-24 08:26, not restarted before this seed. 12/12 components covered (164 threats) in 2346s; category analysis completed cleanly, then 171 x HTTP 507 in mitigations, compound, calibration and LLM dedup (all 157 mitigation calls failed back-to-back), so mitigationCount is 0 throughout and the tokens above are category-analysis tokens only (81 metered successful calls). X-06 alone does not prevent the 507s: MTPLX active memory climbed 20 -> 52.6 GB over the run and is released only when the server idles.

golden-seed-12-mtplx27b-x08.json.note: Wave X BEFORE for prompt tickets: main with X-01 meter, X-06 limiter and X-08 507 backoff, no prompt change; same MTPLX config as seeds 08-11, no supervisor restart. First MTPLX seed with a complete run: 161 identification threats, mitigations on all 149 final threats (580 mitigations, 161 mitigation calls, one per threat), compound (3), calibration and LLM dedup (15 collapsed; 4 dedup groups kept as-is after unparseable replies) all completed in 6989s. 9 HTTP 507s, all recovered by X-08 backoff (6 events, at most 2 backoffs each).

golden-seed-13-mtplx27b-x02.json.note: X-02 (static category/mitigation instructions moved into one byte-identical system message per stage) on top of seed 12 main. Same MTPLX config, no restart. 171 identified, 166 final threats (8 collapsed by dedup, 3 compound), mitigations on 166/166 (790 total, 4.8 each vs 3.9 in seed 12), 7865s, 3 HTTP 507 backoffs all recovered, 4 dedup groups kept after unparseable replies. Also the new canonical golden-threats.json / llm-journal.json.

golden-seed-14-mtplx27b-x07.json.note: X-07 (mitigations after dedup + confidence floor, 3 threats per call) on top of X-02 main 4b78793e. Same MTPLX config, no restart. 173 identified, 161 final (15 collapsed, 3 compound), mitigations on 161/161 (577, 3.6 each), 7366s, 4 HTTP 507 backoffs recovered. Recorded before the bracket-repair fix: 16 of 57 batch replies lacked their closing ] and fell back to single-threat calls, so the measured 194 calls include ~43 avoidable retries (104 mitigation calls; ~61 projected with the fix). Golden regenerated by replay with the fix. Also the new canonical golden-threats.json / llm-journal.json.

New model: BEFORE for every later ticket; not comparable with seeds 08-14.
